title: Principal Engineer-AI/ML
description: Req ID 87608 | GBS Chennai, India, ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited Job Description About the team RPA Products What you can look forward to as Lead AI/ML Engineer: - Plan, introduce, customize, and support development projects for the complete end to end capabilities of OCR/ ICR Product and future RPA Products - Implementation of full -life-cycle OCR/ICR solutions development projects in a cross-functional team of and Artificial Intelligence solutions from requirements gathering to solution delivery - Develop and fine-tune vision-language models, machine learning models, especially for document-based use cases such as PDF, images data extractio - Customize pre-trained models (e.g., LayoutLM, LayoutLMv2/v3, Donut, Tesseract, etc.) for specific business requirements. - Implement OCR pipelines and enhance text recognition for structured and unstructured data - Python (advanced) — FastAPI, ML pipelines. ML frameworks — PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace. Your Profile as Lead AI/ML Engineer: - Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with deep Technical knowledge on AI ML products, technologies, processes and procedure models - 8-12 Years of overall experience and minimum 5+ years experience in AI ML products, primarily with OCR/ICR technologies. - Profound knowledge of programming languages such as Python including ML frameworks/libraries and analytics tools and technology (Microsoft Azure, MLflow, CI/CD, Automations, OCR, etc.) - Few years of experience as a Technical Architect and experience in analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of enterprise scale AI products - ML model design, training & production deployment & OCR model training & fine-tuning - Hands-on experience with OCR technologies (e.g., PaddleOCR, Tesseract). Why should you choose ZF Group in India? Innovative Environment: ZF is at the forefront of technological advancements, offering a dynamic and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and growth. Career Development: ZF is committed to the professional growth of its employees, offering extensive training programs, career development opportunities, and a clear path for advancement. Global Presence: As a part of a global leader in driveline and chassis technology, ZF provides opportunities to work on international projects and collaborate with teams worldwide. Sustainability Focus: ZF is dedicated to sustainability and environmental responsibility, actively working towards creating eco-friendly solutions and reducing its carbon footprint. Employee Well-being: ZF prioritizes the well-being of its employees, providing comprehensive health and wellness programs, flexible work arrangements, and a supportive work-life balance. Be part of our ZF team as Principal Engineer-AI/ML and apply now! Contact Abdul Rahim J

title: Director, Data Platform Engineering
description:
We’re operating modern, secure data and analytics platforms that make it easy for teams to use trusted data for analytics, AI, and decision-making.
You’ll work with us to grow and support an engineering organisation of ~30 people, shaping a platform that operates as a product – is reliable, well‑governed, and delightful to use. If you’re excited about scaling teams, simplifying complexity, and delivering clear outcomes, we’d love to hear from you!
What you’ll do
Lead with impact
Partner with us to set a clear vision and roadmap for our cloud data and analytics products (e.g., Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS), aligned to business value.
Champion the creation of digital, developer-centric platform-as-a-product which provide opinionated self‑service capabilities
Prioritise customer outcomes and a product mindset: clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and continuous feedback loops.
Grow an inclusive, high‑performing engineering team; coach leaders, hire thoughtfully, create a culture of learning and psychological safety.
Create a coherent, coordinated engineering organisation across BI, data management, analytics and data governance - driving one way of working and shared standards.
Design for trust, reliability, and scale
Embed governance, security, privacy, and compliance from the start using tools such as Microsoft Purview and Collibra.
Simplify data ingestion from diverse sources with resilient real‑time and batch pipelines.
Define and uphold standards for reliability, disaster recovery, and data quality—minimising data loss and downtime.
Enable great engineering
Uplift engineering craft and consistency: modern software engineering practices, well‑defined interfaces/APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, and operational excellence.
Drive platform reuse over one‑off delivery: shared building blocks, reference implementations, and inner‑sourcing where it reduces cost and improves quality.
Promote practical, modern data engineering practices (e.g., Python, Spark, dbt) through architecture reviews, coaching, and automation.
Measure what matters: use OKRs, KPIs, and service metrics (SLOs/SLIs) to guide decisions and improve outcomes.
Build strong relationships with partner teams in Sales, Operations, Finance, Risk, and HR—and with suppliers—so delivery is predictable and trusted.
Build a high‑performance delivery culture: predictable planning, clear ownership, fast feedback, and transparency on delivery, reliability, and customer impact.
About you
We welcome different paths and experiences. You don’t need to tick every box to apply—if you’re close, we’d love to talk.
You’ve led senior engineering teams to deliver large‑scale cloud data platforms with clear business impact.
You’re comfortable making and explaining architectural decisions, and you create space for others to contribute.
You bring depth in at least some of: Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, Spark, Python, dbt—and you learn new tools when they’re the right fit.
You care deeply about data security, privacy, and governance, and you’ve used tools like Purview or Collibra (or similar) to make this real.
You communicate clearly with technical and non‑technical audiences, turning complex topics into practical, inclusive narratives.
You’ve led geographically distributed teams, improving team effectiveness, engineering standards, and delivery outcomes.
You’ve set reliability standards and supported both analytical and operational workloads at scale.
How we work
People first : We foster inclusive teams where different perspectives are heard and valued.
Outcomes over optics : We measure success with transparent goals and service metrics.
Craft and pragmatism : We value thoughtful design and automation, balanced with real‑world delivery.
Collaboration : We build with our users and partners, not for them.
One engineering culture : We work as one team across disciplines and locations, with shared standards, respectful challenge, and a bias to reuse what already works.
Why join us
Real impact : Your leadership will shape how the company uses data every day.
Growth : You’ll develop leaders, set strategy, and still stay close to the engineering craft.
Supportive culture : Flexible working, inclusive practices, and time for learning are part of how we operate.
Visibility : You’ll collaborate across business and technology, influencing decisions at senior levels.
If you’re energised by building platforms that help people do their best work with data, we’d love to hear from you!
What you’ll get in return:
High-impact projects: We work on a variety of pioneering AI products and leverage extensive datasets to solve high-value challenges.
Competitive benefits: We offer a strong compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and ongoing investment in career growth and skill development. Industry leadership: We deliver brand-new products that democratize modeling and analytics solutions. Career progression: We provide opportunities for continuous learning and professional development in a work environment of dedicated, highly experienced teams.

We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to the workplace; this role is considered ‘digital first’, which requires attending the office at least one day per week while some teams and colleagues choose to collaborate in the office more frequently. LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
Proud to share LSEG in the India is Great Place to Work certified (Jun ’25 – Jun ’26).
Learn more about life and purpose of our company directly from India colleagues’ video: Bengaluru, India | Where We Work | LSEG
Career Stage:
Director
LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.
Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.
Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.
Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.
Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.
Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

title: Senior SW Development Engineer
description:
Lattice Overview
There is energy here…energy you can feel crackling at any of our international locations. It’s an energy generated by enthusiasm for our work, for our teams, for our results, and for our customers. Lattice is a worldwide community of engineers, designers, and manufacturing operations specialists in partnership with world-class sales, marketing, and support teams, who are developing programmable logic solutions that are changing the industry. Our focus is on R&D, product innovation, and customer service, and to that focus, we bring total commitment and a keenly sharp competitive personality.
Energy feeds on energy. If you flourish in a fast paced, results-oriented environment, if you want to achieve individual success within a “team first” organization, and if you believe you can contribute and succeed in a demanding yet collegial atmosphere, then Lattice may well be just what you’re looking for.
Job Description:
Senior Software Engineer
Lattice Overview
Lattice Semiconductor (NASDAQ: LSCC) is the global leader in smart connectivity solutions, providing market leading intellectual property and low-power, small form-factor devices that enable more than 8,000 global customers to quickly deliver innovative and differentiated cost and power efficient products.
The Company's broad, end-market exposure solves customer problems across the network from the Edge to the Cloud for clients in consumer electronics, industrial equipment, communications infrastructure, computing and automotive. Our technology, long-standing relationships and commitment to world-class support enables our customers to quickly and easily unleash innovative solutions to create a smart, secure and connected world.
Our control, connect and compute solutions enable the Internet of Things to operate safely, easily and more autonomously at the edge of the network core. While you may not see our products, you are interacting with them all day, every day. We make your experience smarter and better-connected. Join Team Lattice and help us continue to drive innovation that creates a smarter, better-connected world. Together, we enable what’s next.
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer to design and develop reference applications for microcontrollers. You will work across the software stack, from drivers and RTOS integration to applications. You will work closely with hardware, and applications teams.
Experience Range: 7 to 10+ years of hands-on experience in developing, optimizing C/C++, Python applications for microcontrollers such as ARM or RISC-V.
Key Responsibilities
Bring up and debug software on new hardware, FPGA prototypes and silicon.
Develop build systems, automated tests and continuous integration flows.
Review code and designs, and mentor junior engineers.
Write technical documentation and support customers and field application engineers.
Design, implement and maintain embedded software in Python, C/C++ for microcontrollers such as Arm Cortex-M and Cortex-A or RISC-V processors.
Port and configure real-time operating systems such as Zephyr, Tock or FreeRTOS, including board support and device drivers.
Develop reference designs and sample applications that show product capabilities to customers.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
7–10 years of embedded software development experience.
Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++ for resource-constrained systems.
Solid understanding of RTOS concepts: scheduling, interrupts, synchronisation and memory management. Hands-on experience with Zephyr, Tock or a similar RTOS.
Good knowledge of RISC-V and/or ARM architecture: exception handling, MPU/MMU, caches and boot process.
Hands-on debugging with JTAG/SWD probes, GDB.
Familiarity with Git, CMake and CI tools.
Additional Information:
This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
India
Lattice recognizes that employees are its greatest asset and the driving force behind success in a highly competitive, global industry.  Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry.
Lattice is an international, service-driven developer of innovative low cost, low power programmable design solutions.  Our global workforce, some 1,000 strong, shares a total commitment to customer success and an unbending will to win.  For more information about how our FPGA, CPLD and programmable power management  devices help our customers unlock their innovation, visit  www.latticesemi.com .  You can also follow us via Twitter, Facebook, or RSS.

At Lattice, we value the diversity of individuals, ideas, perspectives, insights and values, and what they bring to the workplace.  Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates.

title: Software Engineer (C, C++)
description:
Responsibilities Our values Benefits Overview At Net App, our High Achievement Principles shape how we work: we innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel as a team. We have a history of helping customers turn challenges into business opportunities. That’s because we bring new thinking to age-old problems, like how to use data most effectively in the most efficient possible way. As an Engineer with Net App, you’ll have the opportunity to work with modern cloud and container orchestration technologies in a production setting. You’ll play an important role in scaling systems sustainably through automation and evolving them by pushing for changes to improve reliability and velocity. Success profile Ready to be an engineer at Net App? Explore the traits that can help you thrive. Analytical Adaptable Communicator Detail-oriented Quick-thinking Problem solver Responsibilities Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Job category: Engineering Job ID: 136042-en_US Own Every Moment at Net App At Net App, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, Net App is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. Job Summary We are hiring Software Engineers to be involved in development & design of the features for Net App’s flagship storage operating system ONTAP. ONTAP is a feature rich stack with its rich data management capabilities that has tremendous value to our customers and are used in mission critical applications across the world. You will work as part of a team responsible for the development, testing and debugging of distributed software that drives Net App cloud, hybrid-cloud and on-premises solutions. As part of the Research and Development function, the overall focus of the group is on competitive market and customer requirements, supportability, technology advances, product quality, product cost and time-to-market. Software engineers focus on enhancements to existing products as well as new product development. This is an early in career technical position that requires an individual to be systems-focused, creative, team-oriented, technologically savvy, able to work in a small and large cross-functional teams, willing to learn and driven to produce results. Job Requirements Strong foundation in system software design and development. Hands-on programming experience in C, C++, and Python. Deep understanding of Unix/Linux systems programming and multithreaded application development. Solid knowledge of operating system internals and related concepts. Experience in the Storage domain and Distributed Systems is highly desirable. Demonstrated commitment to software engineering best practices, code quality, and continuous improvement. Proven ability to deliver high-quality solutions within aggressive timelines. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders. Understanding of customer deployment environments and experience collaborating with teams beyond engineering. Self-driven, motivated, and adaptable individual with strong ownership, independence, problem-solving skills, and a collaborative mindset. Contribute as a key member of the engineering team in developing new features, sustaining existing functionality, and addressing engineering escalations. Participate throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, debugging, testing, and customer support. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as QA, System Test Engineering, and other engineering groups to understand customer requirements, deliver high-quality solutions, and incorporate valuable feedback into product development. Work effectively with fellow engineers to troubleshoot, analyse, and resolve complex technical challenges. Education A Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering or Computer Science with 4-8 years of experience, or a Master’s Degree; or equivalent experience is required.
